note: Data-driven seat roster. The server builds one MCP tool per seat from this file. Add, remove, or reorder seats here — never in code.

seats.description: Maps a crash signature to its most likely cause pattern, with base rates from prior cases. Unblocks DebugAssist's NEEDS PERSON stall at triage.
seats.headline: Think fast.
seats.name: Crash Triage

seats.description: Critic of any number DebugAssist is about to act on: denominator integrity, construct validity, gaming probe. Adapted from advisor-metric-design.
seats.headline: Measure twice.
seats.name: Metric Design

seats.description: Defines what 'correct' means before the fix: falsifiable acceptance criteria, oracle design, tier of the gate. Adapted from advisor-qe-ic-advisor.
seats.headline: Ship or stop.
seats.name: QE Bar

seats.description: Grades the surface the DebugAssist agent works on: what it holds, what it reaches, what breaks when a piece is missing. Adapted from advisor-harness-design.
seats.headline: Hold it right.
seats.name: Harness Review

seats.description: Reads a failure explanation and its guard: does the guard change a condition or instruct a person? Unblocks DebugAssist's GUARD NOT WRITTEN stall. Adapted from advisor-allspaw.
seats.headline: Conditions, not culprits.
seats.name: Incident Lens

seats.description: Decides whether a question admits an answer from the data: denominator integrity, n≥30 for rates, answerable-at-what-n. Adapted from advisor-ds-ic.
seats.headline: Show the n.
seats.name: Statistical Rigor
Allspaw DebugAssist
seats.headline: Conditions, not culprits.
seats.description: What conditions allowed this failure? Produces guardable conditions with falsifiable tests. Unblocks DebugAssist's GUARD NOT WRITTEN stall.

seats.name: QE-IC DebugAssist
seats.headline: Ship or stop.
seats.description: Is the proposed fix validated? Is the judging test sound? No-vibes rule: every PASS/SOUND names its check and flip condition.

seats.name: Defect Triage
seats.headline: Real defect or not?
seats.description: Is this a real defect? Four-state rule: DEFECT / NOT_A_DEFECT / NEEDS_PERSON / DECLINED. Confidence checked before defect probability.

seats.name: Cause Locator
seats.headline: Where's the cause?
seats.description: Which file and line range most likely contains the cause? Max 3 ranked candidates, confidence as P(fix touches this range).
